case_schema.schema_1_policy: Read existing cases and retain their historical free-text expected-failure semantics; do not use as the implicit schema for new catalogs.
case_schema.schema_2_policy: Require explicit version, explicit expected_failure (null or a structured object), and complete execution_identity supplemental block.
case_schema.old_0_2_6_policy: Read-only historical contract; no in-place migration or hash changes.

canonical_json.list_order: preserved except input_files/reference_files, sorted by logical_role then logical_id
canonical_json.units: must be resolved before identity construction
canonical_json.private_absolute_paths: rejected; identify input bytes with logical IDs and SHA-256
canonical_json.operational_metadata: timestamp/output/temp paths are supplied out of band and omitted; no scientific payload keys are silently filtered

input_file_identity.sha256_and_size_null_rule: Both may be null only when availability_status is MISSING or OPTIONAL_DEPENDENCY; never fabricate a digest.
input_file_identity.content_hashing: InputFileIdentity.from_bytes hashes the bytes, not the path or a caller-provided digest alone.

reuse_conditions: execution_key exactly matches current execution identity
every required result artifact is present as bytes
every artifact byte length and SHA-256 match the recorded values
safe_resume.legacy_0_2_6_runner: An existing source-SHA-only result is refused for resume and left unchanged; no guessed adapter/key is generated.

expected_failure.schema_1: legacy string behavior retained only for historical schema-1 cases
expected_failure.matching: Exact type/stage/reason, exact code when declared, and regex search when declared; any mismatch is not EXPECTED_FAILURE_PASS.

provenance_and_availability.public_private_split: PublicBenchmarkRecord is allowlisted; unknown/internal fields and absolute local paths are rejected.
provenance_and_availability.maturity_rule: A public record must carry an explicit maturity status, authority and decision ID; numerical PASS cannot derive maturity.

documentation_projection.automation_scope: future selected benchmark summaries only; no repository-wide rewrite and no auto-qualification

wp02_discrete_preflight_finding.finding: Common compatibility preflight does not separately validate discrete entities when finite elements are also present.
wp02_discrete_preflight_finding.wp03_action: Record the finding and reserve a future route-local fail-closed validation/test location.

validation_plan.preservation_tests: 0.2.6 registry/result tests and historical v2 case/evidence reading
validation_plan.quality_workflow: .github/workflows/quality.yml workflow_dispatch on exact WP03 SHA; no main dispatch

qf0211_g07_foundation.legacy_compatibility_boundary: Historical schemas/results remain readable and unchanged; source-SHA-only legacy resume is intentionally refused because it is not safe to preserve as reuse behavior.
qf0211_g07_foundation.pass_rule: Every foundation item is YES and exact WP03 validation is terminal success. Report CI run IDs against the frozen HEAD separately; do not amend this tested source to record them. This is not the final QF0211-G07 release gate and does not qualify mechanics.
